description: Saves a named list of tickers to scope screens and subscriptions.

description.description: Free-form notes, up to 500 characters. Stored as `""` when omitted.

id.description: Optional slug: the universe's permanent handle everywhere (`?universe=`, subscribe `universe`, CRUD path). Pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$`: starts with a lowercase letter, then lowercase letters/digits/underscore, 63 chars max; the value is trimmed and lowercased before validation. `top_10` and `top_100` are reserved for built-in universes and rejected with 400. Must be unique within your account. Generated (`u_…`) if omitted.

name.description: Display name, up to 80 characters. Display only: the `id` is what references the universe.

tickers.description: Ticker symbols, up to 10,000. Validated against the tickers we track. `[]` is accepted: an empty universe you can fill later via PATCH.

name: tickerbot_create_universe
